breakdown.description: Boundary section contains incompatible boundary condition types (e.g., periodic vs Dirichlet/Neumann).
breakdown.reason: The agent failed to resolve the conflicting boundary conditions. The original prompt incorrectly specified both Neumann and Dirichlet conditions for the same boundary. The ground truth corrected this by removing the Dirichlet condition. The agent's generated specification repeated the error by including both: "Neumann (zero flux) implemented via ghost node mirroring" and "Dirichlet boundary values set to zero".
